children: US gasoline futures traded near $3.13 a gallon, after a five-session winning streak, after Tuesday’s meeting between President Trump, Energy Secretary Wright, and US refiners.
Talks focused on fuel-blending quotas,  with refiners arguing that it was contributing to higher fuel prices as corn and soybeans surged to nearly three-year highs.
President Trump also urged refiners to build more refineries.
Meanwhile, oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have also continued despite escalating tensions.

Still, EIA data showed US gasoline inventories fell 1.173 million barrels in the week ending August 28th, reflecting continued draw backs in recent weeks while US refiners are operating at 98%, its highest level since August 2018, with several facilities delaying maintenance to keep production elevated.
Heavy driving over the Labor Day weekend is also providing support.
At the same time, Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining infrastructure pushed refinery runs to multi-year lows.

title: Gasoline Fluctuates
